subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should maintainers require redacted current-main Slack Socket Mode reaction envelopes before authorizing a fix, or sponsor a live maintainer reproduction now?
rationale: Source inspection proves handler support but not the first failing boundary in the reporter's live multi-account setup, and an automated fix would be guessing between Slack delivery, OpenClaw filtering, authorization, and liveness.

options.title: Request current-main envelope proof
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for redacted raw Socket Mode reaction envelopes plus gateway trace logs before changing code.

options.title: Sponsor maintainer live repro
options.body: A maintainer with Slack test apps can reproduce the multi-account reaction path directly and turn the first proven drop boundary into a narrow fix.

options.title: Fold into broader Socket Mode diagnosis
options.body: Only merge this into the broader Slack Socket Mode issue if new evidence shows all event families fail, not just reactions.

recommendation.title: Request current-main envelope proof
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask for redacted raw Socket Mode reaction envelopes plus gateway trace logs before changing code.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest history signal for Slack monitor filtering and reaction authorization, which are the central current-code boundaries to inspect.
